historicalFindingSnapshot.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/review-run.ts:117,175-214,262-263 [high] review_run_start independently assembles and persists a review-run Prompt Envelope after the reviewer is already running, but returns only the run/envelope IDs and never delivers assembly.prompt. Its signed ReviewRun.promptHash remains optional caller-controlled input and is only folded into launcherSpecDigest, not required to equal the envelope assembledPromptDigest. agent_prompt can emit only a story-dispatch audit Envelope, so no trusted path proves that the review-run Envelope was the Prompt actually received by the reviewer. A pass can therefore satisfy the new gate while binding a canonical prompt that was never model input, violating the decision contract that the same process that sends the Prompt must calculate/record it. Integrate reviewer dispatch with review-run assembly or otherwise mechanically bind and deliver the exact assembled bytes before accepting pass evidence.

packages/main/src/core/prompt-envelope.ts:82-186 and packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:489-518 — [HIGH] The gate-consumed Prompt Envelope verifier proves only that envelopeId hashes the envelope fields; it never proves roleId equals reviewer lane, rolePrompt matches the registered role render, or the Runtime/Role digests match the actual prompt bytes. assembleFullPromptEnvelope accepts an arbitrary rolePrompt and a roleContract for lattice-review-concept while lane=lattice-review-quality, verifyPromptEnvelopeIntegrity returns true, and a ReviewRun signed over that envelopeId is accepted by verifyReviewRunPromptEnvelope. Repro: build, then assemble a review-run envelope with roleContract concept, rolePrompt ATTACKER-CONTROLLED PROMPT, lane quality; signReviewRun with the returned envelopeId; both verifyReviewRun and verifyReviewRunPromptEnvelope return true. This violates CHK-001 envelope-role-contract-coherence and CHK-003 gate-path shared verification, so a structurally valid but semantically wrong reviewer prompt can become gate evidence. Derive the prompt/contract from the canonical lane inside the trusted assembler or persist enough canonical material to recompute it, enforce roleId===lane for review-run envelopes, and add a gate-path regression test for prompt/role/lane substitution.
